thread:
Maria Chen: quick draft — putting together a small, actionable cold-start activation runbook for low-volume tenants. focus: prefill, batching windows, streaming fallback, and handoff checklist. sharing so we can iterate. :memo:

Aj Patel: love it. can we keep the steps <5 bullets so PDMs can paste to customers? also include a tiny curl example for prefill.

Sam O'Neill: yep. for cold starts i'd recommend a 5–10s batching window for background prefills, shorter for live streams. note on limits: don’t exceed 8 concurrent prefill jobs per tenant to avoid capacity spikes.

Kevin R.: +1. also add an explicit fallback policy: if streaming fails, return cached prefill or a lightweight prompt that tells user to retry. customers hate silent failures.

Maria Chen: draft runbook (high level):
1) Preflight (before go-live): verify model pinned version, region, and quota. ensure KMS keys and audit logging enabled.
2) Prefill strategy: seed KV prefixes for most common prompts/routines. run 1 warm request per expected shard key. TTL: 24h by default, reduce to 4h for high-change tenants.
3) Batching config: set background prefill batch window = 5–10s, realtime request batching = 50–100ms. max batch size 16 for latency-sensitive customers.
4) Streaming fallback: if chunk stream times out >250ms or connection resets, fallback to single-shot generation with a short prompt and tag response as: [fallback-prefill].
5) Hand-off checklist: notify AE/SE with a one-liner summary + link, add to renewal tracker if initial usage <10% of forecast after 7 days.

Aj Patel: can we add a tiny prefill curl?

Maria Chen: sure — example below (customer-facing snippet):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"rw-medium-2026","input":"<seed_prompt>","prefill":true}'
```

Sam O'Neill: for instrumentation, capture: prefill_hit (bool), batch_delay_ms, stream_fallback_count, and first_7d_usage_percentile. wire metrics to console + tenant alert if prefill_hit < 0.6 after live traffic ramp.

Kevin R.: Renewal risk rule proposal: if (first_14d usage < 15% of forecast) OR (support tickets > 3 in first 14d) -> flag owner and run enablement workshop. add cadence: 48h after flag, CS owner schedules 30m call.

Maria Chen: feedback capture template for the workshop (two quick prompts):
- "What part of the flow felt slow or surprising?"
- "Which outputs would you like us to prioritize improving in the next sprint?"
Put answers in the tenant notes under key: onboarding_feedback_1/2.

Aj Patel: can we add a short troubleshooting flow for warmup failures?

Maria Chen: yep — troubleshooting (short):
- symptom: prefill jobs keep failing -> check permission errors (403) and KMS logs.
- symptom: prefills succeed but low hit rate -> inspect shard key distribution + increase diversity of seed prompts.
- symptom: streaming disconnects often -> bump connection keepalive and reduce max chunk size to 2k tokens.

Sam O'Neill: operational tip: schedule a low-traffic rolling prefill every 6 hours for the first 72 hours to keep KV warm without overloading inference pools.

Kevin R.: include a one-click handoff checklist for AE/SE: 1) confirm prefill status screenshot, 2) schedule 30m enablement, 3) confirm billing/quotas. Attach a sample slack message to paste.

Maria Chen: sample AE slack paste: "@ae-team Hi — tenant Acme (ID: 12345) is live. Prefill status: 86% hits, batch window 7s. Can we book a 30m enablement to review usage and collect feedback?"

cs-bot: Reminder: add a follow-up task in /tasks with tag #activation within 48h.

Aj Patel: small UX note — tell customers how to surface fallback responses in their UI (label as "Limited results — try again"). reduces surprise.

Maria Chen: last bits: link to internal config reference (private): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/coldstart-prefill-config (useful for SEs). i'll iterate and trim to a one-page checklist for customer emails.

Sam O'Neill: LGTM. can I take action to turn this into a tiny Google Doc and a one-pager PDF?

Maria Chen: please do. assign back when ready and i'll add renewal-risk triggers into the tenant dashboard. thanks all :pray:
